summary_md: **Vilmer Rose ([@VilmerRose](https://x.com/VilmerRose/status/2115459913791250551))** runs the official **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017** checkpoint (MXFP4 experts + FP8 rest, 1M context) on SGLang with prefill holding 4,500-4,800 tok/s out to 137K tokens, crediting @MiaAI_lab's recipe and an NCCL patch from the FujitsuPolycom/sparkring repo.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - FujitsuPolycom/sparkring: Low-latency collective transport and distributed LLM serving stack for switchless GB10 clusters.

relevance: Long-context prefill numbers and a multi-Spark transport repo for serving a frontier MoE locally.

media.description: Table of per-user generation speed for concurrent users each writing a 600-token answer with thinking off, plain chat vs a 41K-token Hermes-like history, plus whole-server throughput.
media.ocr_text:
Here's the ladder. Each user writes a 600-token answer with thinking off, all at the same time.
Users at once | Speed per user, plain chat | Speed per user, 41K-token history (Hermes-like) | Whole server
1 | 60 tok/s | 53 tok/s | 53-60
2 | 38 | 39 | ~77
4 | 29 | 27 | ~105
8 | 19 | 17 | ~140
16 | 13 | 11 | ~170-200
